name: P_GPU_TDP
definition: Thermal design power / board power of individual AI accelerator card
assumption_rationale: 700W is verified NVIDIA H100/H200 SXM5 TDP; 1000W represents Blackwell B200 baseline
limitations: Does not include CPU, DRAM, network NIC, or fan power

name: R_HOST_OVERHEAD
definition: Ratio of total server power to total GPU board power in an 8-GPU chassis
assumption_rationale: NVIDIA DGX H100 consumes 10.2 kW for 8 x 700W GPUs (5.6 kW GPU power); ratio = 10.2 / 5.6 = 1.82
used_by_equation: Eq. (1): Total Server Power = N_gpu * P_GPU_TDP * R_HOST_OVERHEAD
limitations: Varies with CPU load and PCIe expansion

name: PUE_FACILITY
definition: Power Usage Effectiveness of the data centre facility
assumption_rationale: 1.55 is verified average Indian PUE (tropical climate); 1.40 is modern greenfield target; 1.25 is best-in-class liquid cooled
used_by_equation: Eq. (2): Facility Power (MW) = IT Power (MW) * PUE_FACILITY
limitations: Summer ambient temperatures >42C increase PUE if air-cooled

name: U_FACTOR
definition: Annual average capacity utilization factor of the GPU cluster
assumption_rationale: Large foundation model training clusters achieve 75-85% sustained utilization; 80% is standard planning baseline
used_by_equation: Eq. (3): Annual Energy (TWh) = Facility MW * 8760 * U_FACTOR / 1e6
limitations: Inference clusters show diurnal variation (50-70% avg); training clusters run steady-state

name: WATER_INTENSITY_EVAP
definition: Water consumption for evaporative data centre cooling per kWh of operational energy
assumption_rationale: 1.80 L/kWh is verified global average from IEA Energy & AI Report (2024, p.25); 0.20 reflects closed-loop dry hybrid systems
used_by_equation: Eq. (4): Annual Water (Megaliters) = Annual Energy (kWh) * WATER_INTENSITY / 1e6
limitations: Highly dependent on cooling architecture (evaporative towers vs closed-loop liquid)

name: RACK_POWER_DENSITY
definition: Target electrical power dissipation capacity per physical equipment rack
assumption_rationale: Enterprise racks are 6-10 kW; AI server racks span 40 to 100 kW (HGX H100 to NVL72)
used_by_equation: Eq. (5): Total Racks = IT Power (kW) / RACK_POWER_DENSITY
limitations: Air cooling becomes non-viable above 40 kW/rack

name: DIE_AREA_MM2
definition: Silicon surface area of primary accelerator logic die
assumption_rationale: 814 mm^2 is verified reticle-limit die size for NVIDIA GH100/H100 on TSMC 4N; 1628 mm^2 is dual-die B200
used_by_equation: Eq. (6): Gross dies per 300mm wafer via Murphy equation
limitations: Physical lithography photomask boundary (858 mm^2 theoretical maximum)

name: WAFER_DIAMETER_MM
definition: Diameter of advanced semiconductor silicon wafer
assumption_rationale: All leading-edge logic fabrication (sub-7nm) exclusively utilizes 300mm (12-inch) wafers

name: WAFER_DIE_YIELD
definition: Net functional yield of good logic dies per processed 300mm wafer
assumption_rationale: For massive ~814 mm^2 die on TSMC 4N, gross dies ~63; at 65% yield, net good dies = ~41 per wafer
used_by_equation: Eq. (7): Good Dies / Wafer = Gross Dies * WAFER_DIE_YIELD; Wafer Starts = N_gpu / Good_Dies_Per_Wafer
limitations: Proprietary foundry data; estimates bounded by physical defect density models

name: COWOS_PACKAGES_PER_WAFER
definition: Finished 2.5D accelerator packages produced per 300mm silicon interposer wafer
assumption_rationale: CoWoS interposers span ~3.3x reticle size (~2,500 mm^2), yielding only 14-16 good interposers per 300mm wafer
used_by_equation: Eq. (8): Packaging Interposer Wafers = N_gpu / COWOS_PACKAGES_PER_WAFER
limitations: Key binding bottleneck; TSMC global capacity is ~35,000-40,000 interposer wafers/month

name: HBM_STACKS_PER_GPU
definition: Number of High-Bandwidth Memory die stacks integrated per accelerator package
assumption_rationale: H100/H200 SXM5 incorporates 6 HBM3/HBM3e stacks; B200 incorporates 8 HBM3e stacks
used_by_equation: Eq. (9): Total HBM Stacks = N_gpu * HBM_STACKS_PER_GPU
limitations: Each stack comprises 8 to 12 vertically bonded DRAM dies via TSV
